name: proxmox-mcp
description: Read-only Proxmox VE and Backup Server CLI that tells you, across every client cluster, which guests have a good, verified, recent restore point and which do not.

proxmox_api_token.title: PROXMOX_API_TOKEN
proxmox_api_token.description: Proxmox VE API token as USER@REALM!TOKENID=SECRET (e.g. root@pam!cli=<uuid>); the CLI sends it as PVEAPIToken=...

proxmox_host.title: PROXMOX_HOST
proxmox_host.description: Proxmox VE host name or IP (port 8006).

proxmox_pbs_api_token.title: PROXMOX_PBS_API_TOKEN
proxmox_pbs_api_token.description: Optional. Proxmox Backup Server API token as USER@REALM!TOKENID:SECRET (colon before the secret); needed only for pbs-* commands and PBS columns

proxmox_pbs_host.title: PROXMOX_PBS_HOST
proxmox_pbs_host.description: Optional. Proxmox Backup Server host, host:port, or https://host:port (default port 8007).

proxmox_tls_fingerprint.title: PROXMOX_TLS_FINGERPRINT
proxmox_tls_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the PVE certificate to pin (stock Proxmox is self-signed); shown under the node's Certificates.

proxmox_pbs_tls_fingerprint.title: PROXMOX_PBS_TLS_FINGERPRINT
proxmox_pbs_tls_fingerprint.description: Optional. SHA-256 fingerprint of the PBS certificate to pin.
